messages:
Jen Yang: Quick heads up — PR #4823 updates Node SDK snippets in /docs/sdk/node/examples.md. The docs preview failed link-checker. Anyone free to review code samples + migration blurb? @mike

rocks-ci-bot: (bot) Sorry wrong bot in thread, ignore this — real preview posted below.

docs-ci-bot: Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4823--redwood-docs.netlify.app/sdk/node/examples — checks: link-check failed (broken relative path: ../images/sdk-flow.png)

Mike Zhao: I'm on PTO until 09:00 PT tomorrow, can't do a deep review now. If it's urgent, @sara could you take the snippets?

Sara Patel: Can do quick snippet + link fix. Not ideal for migration guide wording though. I'll pull locally now.

Kevin Choi: I can handle migration wording but I'm on pager. If you tag me I should be able to review in ~3h.

Sara Patel: Found the issue — example refers to `client.config.basePath` (old API). We should switch to `client.defaults.basePath` and add `await client.ensureReady()` in the init snippet. Pushing small commit.

docs-ci-bot: Build re-run started for PR #4823

Sara Patel: Pushed fix in 4823. Added a short migration paragraph under 'Upgrading from 0.x' — @kevin please sanity check phrasing.

docs-ci-bot: All checks passed — preview updated: https://deploy-preview-4823--redwood-docs.netlify.app/sdk/node/examples

Jen Yang: Thanks! We have a merge freeze at 17:00 PT today — can someone approve so we can merge in the 16:50 merge window? Otherwise we'll queue until tomorrow.

Kevin Choi: Read the migration blurb. Clarified a sentence about `ensureReady()` timing and added a minor typo fix. LGTM.

Mike Zhao: Back online. Ran the snippet locally; looks good. Approved the PR.

Jen Yang: Great — merging at 16:50. Also heads up: docs-review rotation has a gap next week (Tue-Wed). Mike was going to cover Tue but now PTO — Kevin can you swap a day? @kevin

Kevin Choi: I can swap: I'll take Tue morning coverage, Mike can do Wed. Noted in the rotation doc.

Mike Zhao: Thanks Kevin — appreciate it. :+1:

Jen Yang: Merged. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :tada:
